semantic_review.a1_failure: With infoblox-client 0.6.2, two of the pre-existing 27 Designate backend tests fail with KeyError 'reason' when constructing InfobloxTimeoutError using the old positional-message interface.
semantic_review.reviewer_basis: Opening-cutoff replay independently installed infoblox-client 0.6.1/0.6.2/0.6.2 for A0/A1/A2 and ran the identical 27-test Designate backend module in all arms. A0 and A2 pass; A1 has exactly the two constructor-interface failures repaired by the maintainer patch. The patch changes existing test fixtures without deleting or skipping tests.
semantic_review.source_effect: The opening source diff changes the sole infoblox-client pin from 0.6.1 to 0.6.2.
semantic_review.target_repair: The maintainer updates the two existing mocked timeout exceptions to pass response and reason; with infoblox-client 0.6.2 the same 27-test module returns to passing.
